Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying points from our security team: 

- SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report (or evidence of an ongoing Type II cycle) and the auditor name.
- Pen test: summary of findings from the most recent external pentest and confirmation of whether remediation tracking is in place. We typically accept a one-page executive summary plus a more detailed technical appendix under NDA.
- Vulnerability management: SLA expectations (Triage SLAs, fix SLAs by severity), scanning cadence (internal/external, authenticated/unauthenticated), and whether you run quarterly or monthly scans.
- Compliance: HHIPAA applicability (we handle cardholder data; we need to confirm PHI boundaries) and GDPR data residency/processing info.

If you can provide the SOC 2 Type II summary and the pen test executive summary today that would be great — we can sign an NDA for any redacted/full technical reports.

Hi Emily / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers below (high level) — happy to dive deeper on the follow-up call or provide additional artifacts under NDA.

SOC 2:
- Status: SOC 2 Type II completed (period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31). Auditor: Meridian Audits LLP.
- What we can share: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (control narrative + auditor opinion) under NDA. We have the artifact ready and can upload to a secure share once the NDA is in place.

Pen Test:
- Last external pentest: 2026-03-22 performed by ExternalPen LLC (independent security firm).
- What we can share: executive summary and remediation status (attached: pen_test_summary_2026-04.pdf). The full technical appendix is available under NDA; we require redaction of customer-identifying data before release.

Vulnerability management (short summary):
- Scanning cadence: authenticated internal scans weekly, external/network scans monthly, and full external pen tests annually (or after major releases).
- Triaging SLA: initial triage within 24-72 hours of detection/receipt for all high/critical findings.
- Remediation SLA: Critical (P0/P1) tracked and targeted for remediation within 30 days; High (P2) targeted within 60 days; Medium/Low prioritized by business impact.
- Tracking: all findings tracked in JIRA with owner, severity, and CVE reference when applicable. We provide monthly remediation status reports to customers on request.
- Disclosure: we operate a coordinated disclosure policy. We will notify affected customers if findings impact customer data. Public disclosure occurs only after remediation or coordinated release with the finder.

Other notes:
- HIPAA/GDPR: Redwood supports GDPR controls (data processing addendum available). For HIPAA, we support Business Associate Agreement (BAA) conversations for covered applications — we’ll need to scope specific PHI flows.
- Bug bounty: we run a limited bug bounty program via HackerOne for incentivized reporting; high-severity findings from the bounty are treated with the same SLAs.

Attachments: pen_test_summary_2026-04.pdf, vuln_management_process_v1.pdf

If helpful, I can share the SOC2 redacted PDF once we have a signed NDA (linked by Marissa in the thread metadata).

-Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
